name: sharp
description: DSH mobile sharp face: pure-JS adaptation over the vendored pngjs/jpeg-js/fflate pins plus hand-written GIF/WebP codecs. Serves the lazy createLazyRequire('sharp') face and the bare ESM spelling for the vendored attachment-local family (see upstream/shims/npm-bridges-c2.js). NOT the upstream package — the libvips binary cannot ride a QuickJS closure.
